answer: Offer operators an honest fleet registry with a retroactive clawback. Anyone may declare every key they run; the declared garden of keys is paid on a terrace of shrinking rates, the second key earning a tenth of the first. Undeclared keys keep full pay only until evidence links them, then every reward they ever earned is clawed back from locked balances. A hidden sybil farm becomes a mirror of its own risk: one leak erases years of income, so declaring is cheaper than hiding.
